sidebar.heading: Redis connections
sidebar.deleteConnDescription: The connection and every grant under it are removed from all backends. This does not touch the Redis server itself. This cannot be undone.
sidebar.modeFailDesc: Every backend rejected the change. Check your access and try again.

dialog.description: Passwords are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Use Share on the sidebar to grant read / write access without revealing the secret.
dialog.backendLocalDesc: Talks to Redis from your local machine. Required for 127.0.0.1 / LAN nodes.
dialog.backendRemoteDesc: Talks to Redis from the team backend. Use for prod / staging behind VPN.
dialog.backendNote: The connection is saved to BOTH backends — credentials get encrypted with each BE's own key. Pick which one this connection defaults to.
dialog.caCertHelp: Custom CA used to verify the node's TLS certificate.
dialog.skipTlsHelp: Accept any node certificate. Insecure — dev / self-signed only.
dialog.clientNamePlaceholder: Optional — skipped if your ACL denies CLIENT
dialog.errAddressRequired: At least one address is required

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.description: Recipients act through this connection without seeing the stored passwords. Read = browse / peek; write = set, delete & expire keys.

panel.noConnectionsHint: No connections yet. Add one from the Redis sidebar tab.
panel.readOnlyBanner: Read-only access — SET TTL, Delete and write commands are disabled for this connection.
panel.commitlessPeek: Commit-less peek — a throwaway subscription collects up to N live messages, then disconnects.
panel.readOnlyModeBanner: Read-only mode — turn on read-write from the connection's ⋯ menu to change data.
panel.matchHint: Plain text matches anywhere in the key (order → *order*). Use * ? [ ] for an exact glob, e.g. order:*
panel.countHint: How many matching keys to load per page. The scan keeps going until this many match or about 1.5 s has passed.
panel.stoppedBudget: scan paused after {{ms}} ms — more keys may match
panel.resizeDetailHint: Drag or use ←/→ to resize · double-click to reset

hints.selectConnBrowse: Select a connection to browse keys.
hints.enterChannel: Enter a channel or pattern and press Peek.
hints.noKeysMatched: No keys matched. Adjust MATCH and scan again.
hints.noMessages: No messages received before the deadline.
hints.noMatchesYet: No matches in the part of the keyspace scanned so far.

console.title: Command console
console.writesTooltipOn: When off, write commands (SET, DEL, …) are rejected. Reads always run.
console.writesTooltipReadonly: Read-only access — write commands are disabled for this connection.
console.emptyHint: Run a command to see its reply here. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter also runs.

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently removes the key from the Redis server. This cannot be undone.

toast.keyEmptied: Key removed — it had no elements left

elementDelete.description: Runs {{cmd}} on "{{key}}". If it was the last element, Redis deletes the key too. This cannot be undone.
elementDelete.listDescription: Removes exactly this element from "{{key}}" — only if position {{index}} still holds the value shown; otherwise nothing changes. If it was the last element, Redis deletes the key too. This cannot be undone.
